evidence.title: Interface Craft: a working library for those committed to designing with uncommon care.

name: Interface Craft
summary: Paid membership library of articles, walkthroughs and videos about designing interfaces with uncommon care.
description: A working library by Josh Puckett for people who design digital products: 40+ articles, interactive walkthroughs, videos, skill files, references and custom tools in thematic collections on a custom platform. A one-time payment gives lifetime access to current and future material; 3 items can be previewed for free, with regional pricing and educational, gift and team options.
contains: 40+ articles, walkthroughs, videos, skill files, references and custom tools
